name: Voice listener QA
description: Find and fix voice and listener regressions in the console: wake word, push-to-talk, command routing, the shared listener rules.
author: AmberX AXF

data.brief:
Voice regression: {{symptom}} (since {{since}}).
Reproduce it from the tests first (framework/spec/check-listeners.mts and the wake-listener, agent-voice and amberx-listeners plugin tests); find the commit that broke it (git log on framework/libs/listeners and those plugins). Fix it on a branch named agent-jobs/listener-qa-{{stamp}} with a test that would have caught it. Web/TS code only (framework Android code is on hold).
Report cause, fix, the new test, and anything you could not reproduce.
